subject: plot builder and latticist do not work from Rattle

messages.author: 3c1a4a3ded70ddb6
messages.subject: plot builder and latticist do not work from Rattle
parts:
This is a newly installed Rattle version 2.6.26 running on Windows 7 64 bit.

I cannot run either plot builder or latticist. (from R or R studio).  When I execute latticist - nothing happens.  When I try plot builder, the appropriate interface appears, but then the program just seizes up.

I have uninstalled R, cleaned up everything and then reinstalled.

Thanks.

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: plot builder and latticist do not work from Rattle
parts:
Any errors should be noted on the R Console. Also, have a look at the Log tab to see what R command Rattle is attempting to execute. Then copy and paste that command into the R console - 
that should give an indication of the problem. With Plot Builder there seems to be some problematic interactions between the GTK libraries and Java at times.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
